description: This file defines the Wizard class for handling conditional formatting rules in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods to create specific rule instances based on rule type strings or conditional objects, facilitating flexible creation of conditional formatting logic.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A class providing a factory interface for creating conditional formatting rule objects based on string identifiers or conditional objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Wizard with a cell range.

methods.name: newRule
methods.description: Creates a new conditional formatting rule object based on the specified rule type.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a WizardInterface object from a Conditional object, based on its condition type.
